description.purpose: The round watchdog of the client calls (OR-SA-15). It carries no schedule of its own: ./door orders one one-shot schedule per round that sent a client call, under a fixed id (`rearm`), and its strike reaches the collector as `in_round_sweep`.
description.use_when: Inside the simple-agent hive, always. It is not a poll (GH #553): a round without a client call orders nothing, and a strike after the result finds no open round and does nothing.
description.not_in_scope: No cron, no recurring schedule; what a lost result means is the collector's sweep.
